text:
terry: Launching L70e (low-latency inference variant) burst pools in eu-central1 (Frankfurt) and sa-east1 (Sao Paulo) 3 live now, very small capacity to start.

deploy-bot: deploy #l70e-33 -> SUCCESS :white_check_mark: (2 zones/region, 10 GPUs/zone)

maria: Burst windows 06:00-20:00 local. These are non-guaranteed nodes and can be preempted for reserved commitments. Per-org rolling cap = 30 GPU-hours/day during ramp.

kevin: Ops note: L70e is optimized for short, latency-sensitive serving (<512 tokens). Not intended for training or sustained batch workloads.

dena: Billing tag = dedicated.burst.l70e. AMs: we'll auto-notify customers who exceed the cap and offer reserved migration options.

sre-oncall: Smoke test scheduled tonight 23:00 UTC. Expect brief elevated errors (~3-6m). Teams: validate region and model-variant fallback + retries.

maria: Quick dev CLI for testing (non-prod):
redwood infer --model gpt-medium --pool l70e --region eu-central1 --priority low

terry: Action items: product teams validate fallback by EOD Thu; infra monitor preemption_rate and egress. Ping me or @maria for any hot issues. :rocket:
